dslRule:
<!id: sourceviewer.useHasCodeMiningProviders>
<!description: Encapsulate null check for fCodeMiningManager by using the hasCodeMiningProviders() method.
This improves encapsulation and readability, making the code less dependent on internal field access.>
<!severity: HINT>

fCodeMiningManager != null :: inClass("org.eclipse.jface.text.source.SourceViewer")
=> hasCodeMiningProviders()
;;
summary: Replaced direct field null check (fCodeMiningManager != null) with a call to the encapsulating method (hasCodeMiningProviders()) within the SourceViewer class.
